newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenia Novolit to list its shares on OTC market.
newsitem.headline: Slovenia Novolit to list its shares on OTC market.

text.p: Slovenian producer of insulation materials, Novolit d.d., will list its shares on the over-the-counter market (OTC) of the Ljubljana Stock Exchange on January 6, the bourse said on Monday.
The company will list 101,045 shares with a nominal value of 1,000 tolars ($7.04) each, representing 45.05 percent of the company's equity, the bourse said.
Novolit will join a batch of 23 newly privatised companies that have been listed on the main or OTC markets of the Ljubljana bourse since the start of the year.
Currently there are 25 companies listed on the main market, while 27 are being traded on the OTC segment of the bourse. -- Novica Mihajlovic, Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
